limits: Five original callers, thirteen transitive helper entries and the registered cleanup callback execute unhooked. All ordinary listed instructions are reached. The cleanup release boundary at 0x13cf70 remains controlled.

Production has typed cache/settings/table/dependencies, reuses three shared game-access helpers and the existing item comparator, and uses actual JNI function pointers. The variadic C method fixture is test-only.

Every frozen connected case, independent result oracle, retained miss/hit/key-change sequence and groups-output alias are preserved. JNI semantics, initialization, registration, ownership and concurrency remain unverified.

Typed UI/settings have a separate verification report. Cleanup preserves the release-call boundary, with null, opaque and mapped pointers and release-time table mutation. The allocator body and live allocator ownership remain unverified.
